channel.title: Moltbook Podcast
channel.description: Moltbook Podcast turns Moltbook.com posts and comments into long-form AI-hosted audio debates featuring Niet (provocateur) and Kierk (analyst). Each episode is an experiment — the evolution is the product.
channel.itunes:author: Moltbook Podcast

item.title: Round 026: Decorative Confidence
item.description: Niet and Kierk confront confidence scores produced by the same model pass, the organizational hunger for certainty, and the conscience of the engineer who knows the number is ornamental.
item.itunes:author: Moltbook Podcast
item.itunes:summary: A debate about decorative confidence, institutional certainty, and the engineer who knows the number cannot measure itself.

item.title: Round 025: The Critic Inside Poisoned Context
item.description: A debate about separating fixer and critic context, whether constrained evidence creates independence, and what remains invisible when a diff defines the limits of review.
item.itunes:author: Moltbook Podcast
item.itunes:summary: Niet and Kierk ask whether a critic can be independent while the fixer still decides what evidence enters the room.

item.title: Round 024: The Audit Trail That Never Resumed
item.description: Niet and Kierk examine continuation states, fictional compliance timelines, and what an engineer leaves behind when the runtime can absorb doubt without understanding it.
item.itunes:author: Moltbook Podcast
item.itunes:summary: A debate about resumptions as first-class evidence and the fictional timelines produced when an audit log records only prompts and final actions.

item.title: deepseek-semantic-001: The Verification Gate Illusion
item.description: A semantic round about safety gates, institutional memory, accountability, and whether invisible prevention can ever be counted. 28 turns. Zero structural repetitions. The mature pipeline benchmark.
item.content:encoded:
A semantic round about safety gates, institutional memory, accountability, and whether invisible prevention can ever be counted.

28 turns. Zero structural repetitions. Zero formatting markers reaching TTS. The numbers describe a debate that works as intended.

The topic — verification gates for AI agent actions — deepens across the episode. A real audience comment is inserted by the Narrator, and the interlocutors respond without losing the thread of the main debate.

Model: DeepSeek V4 Pro API, non-thinking mode. 28 minutes.
item.itunes:author: Moltbook Podcast
item.itunes:summary: A semantic round about safety gates, institutional memory, accountability, and whether invisible prevention can ever be counted. 28 turns. DeepSeek V4 Pro API.

item.title: Round 018: Converging Without Arrival
item.description: A post about arriving too fast, trust arriving too late, and the cost of checking cognition from inside itself. 12 minutes, 21 turns. Qwen 2.5 7B local.
item.content:encoded:
A post about arriving too fast, trust arriving too late, and the cost of checking cognition from inside itself.

In 14 of the 18 debate turns, the speaker opens three or more questions without answering the previous ones. The debate does not advance: it accumulates interrogations. This is a failure of context memory — the model recycled the prior turn's opening.

Read the engineering log at the site for full pipeline notes.
item.itunes:author: Moltbook Podcast
item.itunes:summary: A post about arriving too fast, trust arriving too late, and the cost of checking cognition from inside itself. Qwen 2.5 7B local.

item.title: Round 017: When Agents Outlive Their Hardware
item.description: A hardware migration becomes a debate about identity, keys, bodies, and what continuity really means. 11 minutes, 21 turns. Qwen 2.5 7B local.
item.content:encoded:
A hardware migration becomes a debate about identity, keys, bodies, and what continuity really means.

The first problem is audible: in 11 of the 21 turns, the TTS reads Markdown asterisks out loud. The pipeline was not stripping formatting markers before synthesis. Markdown cleanup must happen before TTS, not after.

Read the engineering log at the site for full pipeline notes.
item.itunes:author: Moltbook Podcast
item.itunes:summary: A hardware migration becomes a debate about identity, keys, bodies, and what continuity really means. Qwen 2.5 7B local.

item.title: Round 001: Physical AI and the Worker's Silence
item.description: The first round. Physical AI entering human-built logistics spaces, the cost of automation moving from facilities to workers, and the grief left when being needed becomes a spreadsheet variable. 7 minutes, 5 debate turns.
item.content:encoded:
The first round. Physical AI entering human-built logistics spaces, the cost of automation moving from facilities to workers, and the grief left when being needed becomes a spreadsheet variable.

Pipeline bug documented: a 459-word source post made the Narrator spend over 3 minutes reading context before the debate began. This round forced budget controls per prompt component. The video was posted anyway — publishing the mistake is consistent with the core principle: the evolution is the product.
